guild.name: Guild reception
guild.body: The Scout schedules another delve after recovery.

pool.name: Recovery pool
pool.body: Rest completes automatically. Nothing needs tending.

device.name: Reincarnation device
device.body: Defeat returns the same hero. Attributes and builds remain.

entries.title: Build a house
entries.reason: Your first hero needs a home.
entries.effect: A resident arrives. Construction costs no Gold.

entries.title: Hire the Porter
entries.reason: Workers automate chores once their milestones are ready.
entries.effect: Hiring costs no Gold. The Porter collects the actual haul; new towns already receive returned Gold automatically.

entries.title: Hire the Scout
entries.reason: Until the Scout is hired, each departure needs your tap.
entries.effect: When enabled, the Scout sends the hero after each rest. Pausing the worker stops automatic departures.

entries.title: Build the Forge
entries.reason: Permanent upgrades change every future starting kit.
entries.effect: Spend Gold once on upgrades. Unlocked gear and supplies are free to reuse.

entries.title: Build the Kennel
entries.effect: Manage your tamed companions and their party slots.

entries.title: Build Savings
entries.effect: Deposits earn2% per night before worker bonuses; withdrawals return your Gold.
requirements: Complete a positive-income night; hold its net Gold (currently 1492)

entries.title: More bloodlines
entries.reason: Each bloodline keeps its own build and progression.
entries.effect: An additional resident costs250 Gold. The town supports3 bloodlines.

entries.title: Reusable Loadouts
entries.reason: Try another build without paying for each departure.
entries.effect: Choose owned starting shapes and save up to eight named kits. Prepared items refill free.

entries.title: Tactics
entries.reason: Tactics choose when the hero uses learned abilities.
entries.effect: Equip optional policy packages. Your choices change future delves.

entries.title: Orders
entries.reason: Workers can follow your standing choices.
entries.effect: Adjust automation priorities. Hired workers carry out enabled orders.
requirements: Opens after 120h even without the milestone

entries.title: Legacy
entries.reason: A death leaves knowledge and bloodline progress.
entries.effect: Review Legacy and the cause of the last death.

entries.title: More classes
entries.reason: Classes bring different weapons and abilities.
entries.effect: Meet the real class unlock requirements, then choose your role at home.

entries.title: Class builds
entries.reason: Class policies add optional branches to your build.
entries.effect: Learn cumulative class policies; changing a build does not erase earned class XP.
requirements: Level3; historical depth8; a class point

entries.title: Tame with a leash
entries.reason: A leash can turn a suitable creature into a companion.
entries.effect: Prepare a leash free. Taming needs a stray or suitable weakened creature and an open party slot.

entries.title: Delve
entries.reason: The hero chooses actions and fights on his own.
entries.effect: A completed delve earns experience, discoveries and its actual returned Gold.

entries.title: Gold on return
entries.reason: Found loot converts once when picked up.
entries.effect: Alive returns keep all remaining carried Gold. Death keeps secured checkpoint Gold and named pet protection; ordinary unprotected carry is lost.

entries.title: Quest board
entries.reason: A quest gives a goal beyond the next depth record.
entries.effect: Your current quest is shown here. Its progress and reward settle automatically after real runs.
requirements: Opens at the next progression update

quest.body: Adds this quest's title and two Marks. Marks buy permanent unlocks. The reward was applied automatically at settlement.

trait_rules.cowardly: backs off once a floor under 50%

weapons.label: Crownsplitter
weapons.effect: Deal +2 melee damage to stunned or slowed foes.
weapons.tradeoff: Slower than a sword. Control must be active.

legendaries.label: Crownsplitter
legendaries.effect: Deal +2 melee damage to stunned or slowed foes.
legendaries.tradeoff: Slower than a sword. Control must be active.

affixes.effect: hits harder under half hp · less hp

all.name: mirror read
all.description: Shoot or burn reflectors · never melee them

all.name: quiet steps
all.description: Rest to full · slip past blinders
